`other`, which is where a source's own edge label lands when no mapping claims it --
with the label kept in the assertion's metadata rather than discarded.
THREE endpoint pairs, not two. Gate 0 loaded the resolved corpus with only
sense -> sense and lexeme -> lexeme declared and silently lost 36,434 of 1,163,659
relations: a meaning pointing at a *word* without naming which of that word's
meanings. §C requires exactly that, 'without inventing sense IDs'. After declaring
`is_symmetric` is the column name deliberately: SYMMETRIC is a reserved word in
PostgreSQL. `cycles_allowed` is declared per predicate rather than cycles being banned
outright -- synonymy is a cycle and is not a defect.

predicates.description: A more general meaning. WordNet's hypernym, Wiktionary's hypernyms.
A more specific meaning; the stated inverse of hypernym, kept as its own edge because a source may state only one direction.
A part, member or substance of this meaning.
The whole this meaning is a part of.
A meaning a source states as equivalent. Symmetric, and a cycle by nature.
A meaning a source states as opposite.
A sibling under the same broader meaning.
Morphologically derived from, or deriving, this word.
A source's own 'related terms', which is weaker than any of the above and is kept as itself rather than promoted.
An inflected form of another word. Word-level: an inflection has no sense of its own.
An alternative spelling of another word.
A cross-reference a dictionary printed. Johnson's 'see' and Bierce's 'see' are different claims and stay separate by source, never merged.
A source edge whose own label has no mapping yet. The label is kept in the assertion's metadata so nothing is lost, and the mapping registry can claim it later.
